briefing: Market is roughly flat-to-slightly-negative today (NASDAQ -0.4%, S&P 500 -0.1%) — not the risk-on setup we look for to deploy new capital. Cash on hand ($189.29) is also well below the $500 threshold needed for a new position, so we're holding all 7 existing positions and letting stop-loss/profit-target rules do their job automatically.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to deploy when a strong opportunity appears. Today our available cash is too low to fund a new position anyway, and the market isn't showing a clear risk-on signal, so the disciplined move is to hold rather than force a trade.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指的是預留在場邊、等待良機出現時才動用的現金。今天我們的可用現金太少，不足以開新倉位，加上市場也沒有明顯的風險偏好（risk-on）訊號，因此最有紀律的做法是持有觀望，而非勉強交易。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today with no dominant catalyst, reflecting a quiet, directionless session rather than any specific negative news event. NASDAQ underperformed the S&P 500 modestly, consistent with mild profit-taking in growth names after recent gains. Without clear conviction in either direction, this looks like consolidation rather than the start of a new trend.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤指數微幅走低，未見明顯的觸發因素，反映市場觀望氣氛濃厚而非受特定利空消息影響。納斯達克指數表現略遜於標普500指數，符合近期成長股在累積漲幅後出現的溫和獲利了結現象。由於多空雙方都缺乏明確方向，這較像是盤整格局，而非新趨勢的開端。
